title: FBI Photo B4
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report containing a single still image of a UAP submitted to AARO, characterized by significant redactions and an unreliable system timestamp.

incidents.summary: A grainy, monochrome still image captured by a U.S. military system showing a small, dark, circular object.
incidents.explanation: The operator was unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, circular object is visible in the center right quadrant
